Wrongly accused of being a terrorist, Aditya is sentenced to death. While serving his time in prison, Aditya masters the game of chess and becomes a champion.
An officer investigates the serial disappearances of high-profile individuals and discovers an unexpected connection among the cases.
Vir, a robot with human emotions and superhuman abilities, sets out to save the day with the help of his friends, Chulbul, a pet donkey, Imli, an eight-year-old and Gintu, his magical jinn.
Vir, Imli, and Chulbul engage in play without any magic, but Gintu's abilities unintentionally transfer to Bunty, who creates a mess until Vir and his friends trick him into returning the powers.

Ishaan gets into a quarrel with safety officer Gyaan, and moments later, an attendant gets shot. Moreover, after a few years, Gyaan is found murdered in a chair in an old mill.
A property owner illegally takes possession of a large tract of land to build a farm resort. However, the CID team learns about it and decides to investigate the land.
An activist who is promoting women empowerment in a village through education gets murdered. The CID team sets out to solve the murder mystery.
When the prime suspect behind the murders commits suicide, the team is taken aback. Soon, ACP Pradyuman and his team find a startling detail.
Team CID is shocked when Radhika confesses to killing her husband Rakesh. Radhika and the team are surprised when they are unable to find his body in his house.
Balveer, an ordinary child, is taken to Pari Lok as a child and granted powers by six fairies, unlocking magical adventures and new responsibilities ahead.
Aladdin, a poor thief, discovers a magical lamp containing a Genie. However, soon he realizes that Zafar, an evil sorcerer, also desires the lamp to rule over Baghdad.
Simsim makes use of a giant mythical snake to attack Parvaz. In the meantime, Ali hopes to find a way to communicate with Poya.
